revisions.description: [DB-R1] Database mapping revised to the ELIPS schema: SA = ielp.SA_HEADER / SA_DETAIL (SA_CODE), orders = ORDER_CYCLE (SA_CODE) and DTP_n_DETAIL (IS_SA), rate = MS_ROUTE_PRICE (inferred), monthly PO = PO_DETAIL; proposed request / sequence / history tables flagged; conflicts recorded; no sample data

objective: To let VPLD perform Service Acceptance (GR) for deliveries finished by the LP, supporting the 3-way matching PR -> PO -> GR/SA.
To validate each delivery against the applicable TC-PBR PO: route, Total KM, PO, rate and calculated cost, before approval.
To generate the SA Number (ILS/TR/{code}/{YYMMDD}{NNNN}), save the SA with a calculation snapshot and update Daily Monitoring, without duplicate SA.
To let VPLD also perform SA for the monthly truck cost (Fixed Cost PR / PO, truck + driver rental per month) once the monthly PO is released.

operation.text: 5.1 Initial Display
Criteria: Order From = 1st day of previous month, Order To = system date (TBD, OQ-14); tab Regular Trip; list loaded automatically.
Access: VPLD (Planner) - approve; IELP Admin - view only (message no. 1); Supplier / Driver - no access (message no. 2). The backend checks the role again on every call.
5.2 Search / Eligible Deliveries
Delivery is listed when Daily status = 'Finish Daily Order' (finished by LP) and SA_CODE is empty, and Order Date is within the criteria (SA-01). Delivery with an SA Number never appears again.
For every row the system calculates route, Total KM, PO, rate and cost (5.3) and shows the validation result.
5.3 Calculation
5.3.1 Route
Legs = finished cycles (Finish Cycle time set), From -> To; location name -> Master Location code. Order Route = first From + every To.
5.3.2 Total KM
KM of a leg = Master Mileage From -> To with status Active (directional). Total KM = sum, 2 decimals.
5.3.3 PO mapping
Candidates: PO type TC-PBR, same trucking company code, validity period covers the Order Date. A PO of another month is never used unless its validity covers the date.
None: PO Not Found. Only inactive (not Approved / Auto Approved): PO Not Active. More than one active: Multiple PO Found (no manual choice).
Rate = PO rate per KM (Mileage Cost IDR/Km from E-Catalogue at PR time). Never hard-coded.
5.3.4 Cost
Delivery Cost = round(Total KM x PO Rate per KM) in PO currency. Rounding rule TBD (OQ-07). Fix Cost is not part of this screen (OQ-08).
5.3.5 Validation rules

rows: Daily status is not Finish Daily Order
Delivery already has an SA Number
No code for the trucking company
No finished cycle, or a cycle location has no Master Location code
A leg From -> To has no active Master Mileage
No TC-PBR PO of the trucking company valid on the order date
PO found but status not Approved / Auto Approved
More than one active PO covers the order date
PO has no rate per KM
Cost at Approve differs from the cost shown (Approve only)

operation.text: A row with any issue cannot be selected; all issues are shown.
5.4 Calculation Detail
Popup with delivery info, legs and KM, PO and cost formula, validation list. Read only.
5.5 Approve - Confirmation
Approve enabled for VPLD with >= 1 selected row. Confirmation (message no. 5) with summary per trucking company + PO.
5.6 Approve - Server Processing (one transaction)
Check role VPLD (message no. 8) and request id: a request id already processed returns the stored result; still processing: message no. 11.
Lock the selected Daily orders and revalidate each (5.2, 5.3) incl. cost shown vs recalculated (SA-V13).
Any failure: rollback, nothing approved, message no. 7 with the list (all-or-nothing, OQ-09).
Group by trucking company + PO. Per group: next sequence (5.7), SA Number, insert SA header and details with calculation snapshot.
Update Daily order: status 'SA Approved', SA_CODE, SA_DT, SA_BY; write Daily history 'SA Approval' and SA audit.
Commit; message no. 6; approved rows leave the list and appear in SA Monitoring. Any DB error: rollback, message no. 10.
5.7 SA Number
ILS/TR/{Trucking Company Code}/{YYMMDD}{Sequence 4}, e.g. ILS/TR/DNX/2611040001. YYMMDD = approval (server) date.
Sequence scope configurable: per trucking company per date (default) or global per date (OQ-01). Starts at 0001 per date, max 9999.
Concurrency: sequence row locked and incremented inside the approval transaction; unique index on SA_CODE; rollback returns the number.
5.8 Post-approval
The approved amount is kept in the SA detail snapshot; later PO / master changes do not change it.
Daily Monitoring shows the SA Number; Order Detail no longer offers 'Proses ke SA'.
5.9 Monthly Truck (Fixed Cost)
Listed: monthly PO (PR type Fixed Cost) with status Approved / Auto Approved (released), without SA Number, production month overlapping Order From - To. Pending / Rejected PO are not listed.

rows: No code for the trucking company

Amount at Approve differs from the one shown (Approve only)

operation.text: Approve: same as 5.5 - 5.6 (VPLD, confirmation message no. 12, revalidation, all-or-nothing, request id, rollback). One SA per monthly PO; SA Number same format and sequence (5.7); header SA type MONTHLY with one detail (PO, PR, month, amount snapshot); the monthly PO gets the SA Number.
The monthly SA appears in SA Monitoring with SA Type 'Monthly Truck' and follows the same PAS interface.
5.10 Open Questions

rows: SA sequence scope: per trucking company per date or global per date?
Definition of Inter Plant Trip vs Regular Trip.
Meaning / source of the Service column ('CE').
Storage of PO type, validity, rate per KM, currency.
PO match on route when one LP has several TC-PBR POs in a month?
Location codes stored on orders / cycles?
Rounding rule of cost and Total KM.
Fix Cost (monthly price) in this screen or not?
All-or-nothing per request or partial per trucking company group?
SA statuses after approval, SA cancellation.
Relation to Proses ke PAS / SA Approved with PO Number.
Which VPLD roles / levels may approve? Amount limit?
'Finished by LP' = Finish Daily Order only, or all cycles Finish + container?
Default date range; max rows per approval request.
Monthly truck: SA allowed before / during / after the service month?
Monthly truck: full amount or deductions (truck not available, KPI, partial month)?
Monthly truck: one SA per PO, or per trucking company and month with the delivery SA? Different SA type code?
PR / PO sequence > 1 (additional Fixed Cost) as own row?

operation.text: Conflicts (UISS / code vs ELIPS schema) - application not changed

items: G-SA-01 SA number length: UISS / code: SA_NO Char 22 (sa-rules.js saNumber). DB: SA_CODE varchar(16); SA_HEADER_ID varchar(20). Recommendation: Shorten the SA number format or widen SA_CODE (DB change request)

G-SA-02 Amounts as text: UISS / code: Numeric KM / price / cost. DB: SA_DETAIL.PRICE, TOTAL_PRICE varchar(100); TOTAL_TRIP varchar(10); SA_HEADER.SA_TOTAL varchar(5). Recommendation: Store numbers as text with fixed format or change types
G-SA-03 Total KM / rate per KM: UISS / code: TOTAL_KM, RATE_PER_KM, CURRENCY on SA. DB: No such columns (ROUTE_PRICE_ID -> MS_ROUTE_PRICE). Recommendation: Derive from MS_ROUTE_PRICE / TB_M_MILEAGE
G-SA-04 Status codes: UISS / code: Text statuses. DB: SA_HEADER.STATUS_CODE varchar(1), SA_DETAIL.STATUS_CODE varchar(2), SA_TYPE varchar(1). Recommendation: Code values TBD
G-SA-05 Approval request / sequence / history: UISS / code: TB_R_SA_APPROVAL_REQUEST, TB_M_SA_SEQUENCE, TB_H_SA. DB: Not in ELIPS. Recommendation: Confirm whether needed (DB change request)
